Laura — requesting executive approval for a concession package for CrescentTech (DEAL-4729). Customer is a fast-growing health analytics startup; strategic rationale: they are a reference opportunity in our healthcare vertical and plan to move production workloads to Redwood Dedicated in Y2.

Summary of recommended package (Deal Desk rec):
- Commit: 3 years (Jan 1 2027 — Dec 31 2029).
- Year 1 effective discount: 42% off our published unit rates (compromise from their 50% ask).
- Onboarding credit: $40k converted to PS credit, amortized over 12 months and contingent on milestone acceptance.
- Uplift language: If YoY usage growth <= 30% -> 0% uplift; if >30% -> uplift capped at +7% per year.
- Renewal parity: limited to unit price only, applies for 12 months post-renewal, requires 60 days written notice from customer to exercise; does NOT apply to new feature surcharges or add-on products.
- Safeguards: minimum committed spend: $35k / month (annualized $420k) or contract terminates for non-payment; automatic fallbacks to standard list pricing if Redwood's input costs increase >12% YoY (with good-faith documentation).

Mitigations: Aditya confirmed margin remains positive under projected volumes; companion clause converts onboarding credit into amortized PS credit; legal to add a clawback if the customer terminates early.

Requested action: Exec approval to allow 42% entry discount + the limited renewal parity + capped uplift (DEAL-4729). If approved, Deal Desk will prepare the redline and CLM record, and Legal will finalize language.

Attached: one-pager approval recommendation + proposed contract clause (renewal-proposal-draft.docx).
